source: Adds to pricing.json what a per-request price needs; pricing.json itself is unchanged because its sha256 is part of the tier-1 and tier-2 results provenance. cache_write_1h is the 1-hour cache write at 2x the input price of the same tier. A tier applies to a whole request whose prompt tokens (input + cache read + cache write) are above above_prompt_tokens: Haiku 5.5 costs $0.50 / $2.50 above 100K prompt tokens (pricing.json source note); its cache prices in that tier are derived as in pricing.json (write 1.25x and 2x input, read 0.1x input).
